title: Spatiotemporal Bisection Dispute Proof Specification (3D Octree Merkle Path & Multimodal Conservation Verification)
description: Cryptographically authenticated evidence format resolving physical robotic task disputes via interactive 3D octree Merkle bisection paths and multimodal sensor telemetry conservation verification (AER Appendix C.1). Compresses volumetric telemetry to a single dispute voxel for sub-200k gas on-chain zero-knowledge verification.

schema_version.description: Semantic versioning string of this formal schema specification (e.g. 1.0.0).

dispute_id.description: Unique 32-byte cryptographic identifier for the formal dispute proceeding.

task_id.description: Target on-chain escrow contract identifier under dispute.

challenger_node_id.description: EVM address of the complaining challenger asserting physical contract violation.

defendant_node_id.description: EVM address of the executor node defending physical telemetry integrity.

dispute_category.description: Deterministic classification of physical or spatial conservation violation.

voxel_coordinates.description: Disputed 3D spatial coordinate vector [x, y, z] in meters relative to reference spatial datum.

timestamp_frame_ms.description: Temporal offset in milliseconds from execution commencement.

frame_duration_ms.description: Discrete temporal sampling window duration of the disputed telemetry frame.

level.description: Hierarchical depth level within the 3D octree spatial decomposition.

sibling_hashes.description: 7 sibling octant hashes within the 8-ary spatial tree.

node_hash.description: Composite node digest binding the octant leaf or intermediate branch.

merkle_bisection_path.description: O(log N) Merkle path isolating the specific spatial dispute voxel from comprehensive telemetry.

se3_pose_matrix.description: Homogeneous 4x4 SE(3) transformation matrix representing spatial position and orientation.

motor_current_amperes.description: Discrete actuator electrical current measurements in Amperes.

battery_delta_coulombs.description: Integrated Coulomb charge differential over the frame sampling window.

lidar_point_cloud_hash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic digest of the raw point cloud / depth array frame.

proof_circuit.description: Canonical on-chain verifier circuit identifier (e.g. PhysicalConservationDisputeVerifier_v1).

proof_points_a.description: G1 affine point A in Groth16 proof format.

proof_points_b.description: G2 affine point B in Groth16 proof format.

proof_points_c.description: G1 affine point C in Groth16 proof format.

public_inputs.description: Public signals evaluated by the on-chain bilinear pairing precompile.

zk_snark_proof.description: Succinct zero-knowledge proof establishing that recorded telemetry mathematically violates physical conservation or boundary constraints.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds recording dispute initiation.

challenger_signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA cryptographic signature of the challenger asserting dispute evidence validity.
